dz: 斐迪南·麦哲伦的五艘船从塞维利亚起航，开始环球航行。巴斯克第二号指挥官胡安·塞巴斯蒂安·埃尔卡诺将在麦哲伦在菲律宾去世后完成这次探险。
de: Ferdinand Magellan's five ships set sail from Seville to circumnavigate the globe. The Basque second-in-command Juan Sebastián Elcano will complete the expedition after Magellan's death in the Philippines.

de: The naval Battle of Saint-Mathieu, during the War of the League of Cambrai, sees the simultaneous destruction of the Breton ship La Cordelière and the English ship The Regent.

de: Yekuno Amlak takes the imperial throne of Ethiopia, restoring the Solomonic dynasty to power after a 100-year Zagwe interregnum.

te: The Battle of Azaz ends with a humiliating retreat of the Byzantine emperor, Romanos III Argyros, against the Mirdasid …
dz: 阿扎兹战役以拜占庭皇帝罗曼诺斯三世·阿吉罗斯对阿勒颇的米尔达西德统治者的羞辱而告终. 撤退后堕入了一场暴风雨,其中罗曼诺斯本人几乎无法逃脱被俘.
de: The Battle of Azaz ends with a humiliating retreat of the Byzantine emperor, Romanos III Argyros, against the Mirdasid rulers of Aleppo. The retreat degenerates into a rout, in which Romanos himself barely escapes capture.

de: Battle of Maldon: The English, led by Byrhtnoth, Ealdorman of Essex, are defeated by a band of inland-raiding Vikings near Maldon, Essex.
